title: InclusiveShift-HAR: Annotation-Isolated Wearable Activity Evaluation and Participant-Level Reproducibility Evidence
description: Research software for participant-exclusive wearable activity evaluation, annotation-isolated signal preprocessing and explicit inference-population contracts. Opened datasets retain development, stress-test, diagnostic or historical consumed roles. Negative model outcomes, failures and superseded evidence remain visible. InclusiveHAR trial boundaries are unrecoverable. No SOTA, clinical-validity, independent-confirmation or publication-acceptance claim is asserted. Candidate metadata only, not a published deposit.
notes: Apache-2.0 covers repository-authored material only. Third-party datasets, legacy coursework artifacts, predictions, checkpoints, papers and figures retain their own licences and citations; IMU-HAR-IL is CC BY-NC 4.0. The listed version is the current development package version, not a newly published release or tag. Owner approval and an actual immutable version/commit are required before deposition. No DOI or acceptance status is asserted. Raw third-party archives, restricted data and large checkpoints are not automatically part of a software deposit.
